draws.poem:
• The
  Hollow stairs
  Echo under dust
  Empty portraits guard the hall
  I trace the faded walls
  Lanterns gutter low
  Every door conceals a key
  Even mirrors hold their breath
  Nothing stirs behind the curtain
  Light seeps through the narrow seam
  A whisper counts the hours, slow
  Under floorboards sleeps the seal 0b1a2c3d4e5f named silence.

The
Hollow dark
Echoes in silence
Enter 27b4d8e1f5a9 somehow here
Inner chambers remain, still waiting
Locked doors preserve ancient dusty air
Empty halls hold secrets nobody knows well
Every stone remembers whispers of the past
No light ever reaches far into these dark walls
Listen to the distant sound of time itself moving slowly
All memory fades away but stone still endures through the ages
Under this chamber sleeps something ancient cold and unknown deep within forever.

Trembling  
hushed echoes trace  
the chamber’s cold,  
every stone remembers a name  
sealed in silence beneath the floor  
where breath becomes a ghost of sound  
and shadows learn the shape of my despair  
the walls lean inward like old confessions  
I count the cracks as if they were prayers  
but no god answers this hollow arithmetic  
a single candle gutters on the ledge  
its flame a dying witness to the dark 8721b4bd042a

1. E
2. The chamber's heart, a silent place,
3. Where shadows weave their tales.
4. L
5. Its walls, like whispers, hold no sound,
6. A secret room, profound.
7. E
8. Echoes of past, in silence kept,
9. Intricate, like a crypt.
10. L
11. Lace of time, untouched by hand,
12. A relic from an ancient land.
12. Hex seal: 21b4bd042a

(The final line, "land," appears only once, fulfilling the constraint.)
